title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
reason: Market-moving regulatory approval bringing crypto trading models to Wall Street, confirmed by multiple sources.

sources.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”
US regulators are opening the door to stock-based perpetual futures, extending a popular crypto trading product into traditional markets amid ongoing legal disputes.

title: SEC division views Canton Coin as digital commodity in no-action letter
reason: Important regulatory clarification from the SEC defining a token as a digital commodity, reducing legal uncertainty.

sources.summary: SEC's Division of Corporation Finance won't recommend enforcement over Canton Coin's programmatic issuance, calling CC a digital commodity.
